video.title: The Real Reason I Still Do Jiu-Jitsu
video.description:
The final personal story from the livestream: injuries, almost quitting jiu-jitsu during a weight-loss push, the cost of hard training, and why the people and shared self-improvement keep Toby showing up.

Edit note: Kept continuous because it naturally lands as the closing essay of the livestream.
